finalText:
Redis died at 02:14:07, `ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`. Cache fell back to direct store reads. The store buckled: 173 `TimeoutError` after 5000ms. Queue depth climbed 52 to 568, past the 500 cap. All 13 reconnect tries failed. At 02:31:44 worker-2 hit `JavaScript heap out of memory`, and 8s later the supervisor killed the group.

Redis is the root cause. Everything else is fallout.
